summary: Verified 'Selected' link removal from all navs (desktop header, mobile hamburger, footer). /selected route still renders without JS errors. Gedraaid page loads tracks from backend API GET /api/now-playing/recent (not localStorage), search + day-select still function. Backend poller healthy: polls=28, started_at set, last_error=null, 1 track persisted in Mongo and returned via API.
critical_code_review_comments: useRecentPlays still writes to localStorage for iTunes cover cache (COVER_CACHE_KEY). This is fine (only cover-image cache, not the track list), but note that when localStorage was cleared during testing, the reload correctly re-fetched tracks from server (3 keys reappeared from cookie/consent, not from tracks) — server-side source of truth confirmed.
Backend has only 1 track stored after ~5 min of polling; this is expected because tracks only insert when a new song plays. Consider a UI empty-state hint (already present in PlayedPage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 review items verified passing against https://blend-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. Diagnostics endpoint: /api/diagnostics/poller returns {polls, started_at, last_error:null}. Recent endpoint returns {tracks:[...]}. Frontend fires the recent endpoint on mount (and every 30s) and renders played-song-row entries.
